gdx-teavm
https://github.com/xpenatan/gdx-teavm

The following files under teavm/src/main/java/ are modified copies of gdx-teavm
1.6.2 classes. They keep the upstream package and class name so they shadow the
dependency's versions in the Web build:

  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/WebApplication.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/WebInput.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/WebNet.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/assetloader/AssetDownloadImpl.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/dom/impl/WebWindow.java

They have been modified for this project; the changes are recorded in the
repository history. Upstream @author tags are retained in the source files.

Original classes in the same package (not derived from gdx-teavm):

  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/BrowserFiber.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/PacedWebGraphics.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/WebGpuContextSignal.java
  com/github/xpenatan/gdx/teavm/backends/web/WebResumeDiagnostics.java

License: Apache License 2.0 — see LICENSE in this directory.

Original authors include xpenatan (gdx-teavm) and noblemaster (the libGDX GWT
input backend that gdx-teavm's WebInput and WebNet derive from).
